suite: Daily companion and independent Home preview

results.name: Five life contexts are explicitly self-reported and theme cannot change any daily card
No-data and undisclosed context remain useful without clinical defaults
Thirty-day freshness is labeled a product rule and stale context pauses stage prompts until reconfirmed
Invalid input, unknown metadata and corrupt stores cannot be overwritten by a save
Snapshots block other-tab changes, deletion and missing snapshots without losing records
A backward device clock cannot silently replace a newer context or routine
All six actual Home categories preserve entered zero, null and original units without constructing scores
Old observations and previous-day check-ins stay saved but do not drive todays prompts
Observation window is exactly today plus six calendar days and preserves missing readings
Recent postmenopausal bleeding is source-linked, undismissable and labeled historical when appropriate
No bleeding, missed reading and undisclosed observation context never create an after-menopause bleeding finding
Newer ordinary, private or absent bleeding entries cannot hide earlier explicit care-relevant bleeding
All-window care priority favors explicit postmenopausal context and never borrows conflicted daily context
After-birth bleeding stays in after-birth context and is never used to reset a cycle
Contradictory explicit observation context invites review and suppresses context-specific comfort
An entered pain number does not choose treatment, identify a period or use an arbitrary clinical threshold
Poor sleep in explicitly reported menopause context offers comfort without claiming a hot-flush treatment
TTC folic-acid prompt asks a professional and does not prescribe a dose or quantify fertility
Low mood uses worldwide support only for a current dated self-report
Unreadable and denied source stores are reported without recovery writes or false reassuring prompts
Routine completion is reversible per local day, protects stale writers and never completes a care note
International travel and DST retain original local completion dates and context without corrupting history
Routine times include midnight, validate strictly and only produce an in-app local cue
Full-page form saves and restores explicit context, edits contraception and requires fresh confirmation
Dirty context and routine drafts survive denied writes and other-tab changes until explicitly reopened
Stale rendered completion controls cannot recreate deleted completion data
Home preview needs no forms, prioritizes care, exposes why/source/edit links and never writes data
An actual same-page Home form save immediately updates the daily preview and failed saves emit no success event
Same-page record changes refresh daily reading output without replacing unsaved context or routine drafts
Routine cue updates while open at the selected time, clears on pagehide and refreshes on return
Midnight, focus and back navigation refresh dated records and completion without duplicates or writes
Every static and dynamic source button resolves; local record links exist and readable assets are present

scope: Synthetic records, actual strict readers and isolated DOM. No clinical validity, screen-reader or visual-layout claim.
